<!--
  An email sign-up: heading, one sentence, an email field and a button, with an optional consent line and
  picture. Axes: layout (inline, stacked, split), terms (show, hide), tone (default, muted), align (start,
  center).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type NewsletterFormProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    label: string;
    submit: string;
    consent?: string;
    layout?: "inline" | "stacked" | "split";
    terms?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    align?: "start" | "center";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    label,
    submit,
    consent,
    layout = "inline",
    terms = "hide",
    tone = "default",
    align = "center",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: NewsletterFormProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={text}
  tone={tone}
  align={align}
  layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
  media={{ show: ((layout as string) === "split") }}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Form
    method="dialog"
    class={cn("w-full max-w-md", (((align as string) === "center") ? "mx-auto" : ""))}
    data-testid="newsletter-form"
  >
    <Label for={tpl("{0}-email", id)} class="sr-only">
      {label}
    </Label>
    <Group
      gap="2"
      align="start"
      class={cn("w-full", (((layout as string) === "stacked") ? "flex-col items-stretch" : "flex-wrap"))}
    >
      <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
      <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" data-testid="submit">
        {submit}
      </Button>
    </Group>
    {#if (((terms as string) === "show") && consent)}
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="consent">
        {consent}
      </Text>
    {/if}
  </Form>
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
